decisions.name: HNQ-VZP8-TWNRX v1 scan derivative
decisions.reason: The three scan-only pages reproduce the same submission, version, fields and page sequence as the born-digital portal export. The searchable born-digital copy is retained and the redundant scan is excluded.

decisions.name: HQB-6T2F-9M76H v1 repeated export
decisions.reason: The two exports were generated one second apart and have the same page count, embedded-text lengths and perceptual page hashes. One canonical copy is retained.

decisions.name: Fourteen multi-version submission groups
decisions.reason: Versions were compared by fields, attachment lists, revision history, dates and rendered pages. Changed or corrected versions remain separate records because they are not duplicates.

decisions.name: Submission-ID-only and prefixed filenames
decisions.reason: Ambiguous storage prefixes, the '(1)' copy label and one missing leading H were removed from displayed names. Canonical names now show date, form title, submission ID and version.

decisions.name: Five OCR pages
decisions.reason: All five scan-only pages produced readable OCR. Three belonged to the excluded HNQ scan duplicate; the remaining two were the HNJ scan derivative now replaced by the page-identical born-digital portal original.

decisions.name: HNF-P7H3-DCN87 interim report
decisions.reason: The two supplied files are byte-identical exports of the same July 30, 2018 submission. One canonical born-digital copy is retained as a new record.

decisions.name: HNJ-P0ZX-8AVDS summary report
decisions.reason: The two newly supplied files are byte-identical and reproduce the same submission, version, fields and pages as the existing scan. The searchable born-digital copy replaces that scan; no second record is created.
